lines.zh: 我端着茶，慢慢在殿里走。
lines.en: I carry tea and walk slowly through the temple hall.

lines.zh: 我的步子很轻，几乎没声。
lines.en: My steps are light, almost silent.

lines.zh: 我走到柱子边，停下来看看。
lines.en: I walk to the pillar and pause to look.

lines.zh: 石阶很长，我一格格上去。
lines.en: The stone stairs are long; I climb them step by step.

lines.zh: 我绕着殿心转，像在巡视。
lines.en: I circle the temple centre as if on patrol.

lines.zh: 我托着盘子，走得很稳。
lines.en: I balance the tray and walk very steadily.

lines.zh: 我往窗边走，光落在肩上。
lines.en: I move toward the window and light falls on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到门口，看看天色。
lines.en: I shift slowly to the doorway to check the sky.

lines.zh: 我用脚尖试了试地砖，再落脚。
lines.en: I test the tile with my toe, then set my foot down.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里走出来，走进光里。
lines.en: I come out of the shade into the light.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根走，不踩门槛。
lines.en: I walk along the wall and avoid the threshold.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，灰尘都让开了。
lines.en: Dust seems to make way where I walk.

lines.zh: 我背着手，慢慢踱过去。
lines.en: Hands behind my back, I stroll over.

lines.zh: 我一步一顿，像在数呼吸。
lines.en: I walk with pauses, as if counting breaths.

lines.zh: 我站着，双手交叠在腹前。
lines.en: I stand with my hands folded before me.

lines.zh: 我微笑，不说话也很久了。
lines.en: I smile, and have been silent a long while.

lines.zh: 我在这里等愿意学的人。
lines.en: I wait here for those willing to learn.

lines.zh: 我的影子在殿里一动不动。
lines.en: My shadow in the hall does not stir.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看了一下天，又低下。
lines.en: I glance up at the sky, then lower my eyes.

lines.zh: 我数着柱子，一共八根。
lines.en: I count the pillars; there are eight.

lines.zh: 我把手放在茶壶上，暖的。
lines.en: I rest my hand on the pot; it is warm.

lines.zh: 我很安静，安静得有点过分。
lines.en: I am quiet, a little too quiet.

lines.zh: 我闭着眼，像在看别处。
lines.en: My eyes are closed, as if watching elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我站在这块砖上，很久没挪。
lines.en: I have stood on this tile a long time.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸慢到你听不见。
lines.en: My breathing is too slow for you to hear.

lines.zh: 殿里的风，我知道它从哪来。
lines.en: I know where the draught in this hall comes from.

lines.zh: 我把袖子理了理，摆正。
lines.en: I smooth my sleeve and straighten it.

lines.zh: 我不催人，时间在这儿很慢。
lines.en: I hurry no one; time moves slowly here.

lines.zh: 你终于上来了。
lines.en: You have finally come up.

lines.zh: 你的气还湿着，刚练过？
lines.en: Your ki is still damp; have you been training?

lines.zh: 先站好，别急着说话。
lines.en: Stand properly first, and do not rush to speak.

lines.zh: 我看你的骨架，还撑得住。
lines.en: I look at your frame; it can still bear weight.

lines.zh: 你眼里有火，这很好。
lines.en: There is fire in your eyes; that is good.

lines.zh: 你想变强，我能看出来。
lines.en: You want to become stronger; I can see it.

lines.zh: 我比你先在这儿站了很多年。
lines.en: I stood here many years before you came.

lines.zh: 你的礼数少了，不过没关系。
lines.en: Your manners are lacking, but never mind.

lines.zh: 我微微低头，算是回礼。
lines.en: I incline my head slightly as a return greeting.

lines.zh: 你别紧张，我不打人。
lines.en: Do not be nervous; I do not strike people.

lines.zh: 你站在我面前，还差些火候。
lines.en: Standing before me, you still lack seasoning.

lines.zh: 教你之前，我得看看你心性。
lines.en: Before teaching you, I must see your nature.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱，先静下来。
lines.en: Your breathing is uneven; calm it first.

lines.zh: 我把茶放下，慢慢看你。
lines.en: I set down the tea and look at you slowly.

lines.zh: 你还年轻，路还长。
lines.en: You are still young, and the road is long.

lines.zh: 我等着你自己开口。
lines.en: I wait for you to speak first.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡了一下，不碍事。
lines.en: I raise a hand to block; it is nothing.

lines.zh: 你打中我，我反而笑了。
lines.en: You hit me and I only smile.

lines.zh: 这一下，力气用得不对。
lines.en: That blow used your strength wrongly.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，整理衣襟。
lines.en: I step back half a pace and straighten my collar.

lines.zh: 我不生气，只是有点失望。
lines.en: I am not angry, only a little disappointed.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸被打的地方。
lines.en: I touch the spot you struck.

lines.zh: 你还得学会控制力道。
lines.en: You still must learn to control your force.

lines.zh: 我咳了一下，很轻。
lines.en: I cough once, very softly.

lines.zh: 我站稳了，没什么。
lines.en: I steady myself; it is nothing.

lines.zh: 打师父，是要付学费的。
lines.en: Striking your teacher comes with a fee.

lines.zh: 我不需要你的东西，卡林塔自有。
lines.en: I need nothing of yours; Korin Tower provides.

lines.zh: 你带了吃的？放桌上吧。
lines.en: Did you bring food? Leave it on the table.

lines.zh: 茶我有，你留着水。
lines.en: I have tea; keep your water.

lines.zh: 你的礼物，我记在心里。
lines.en: I will remember your gift.

lines.zh: 光亮了些，你点了灯。
lines.en: It is brighter now; you lit a lamp.

lines.zh: 我不贪，但茶可以再来一杯。
lines.en: I am not greedy, though another cup would do.

lines.zh: 你把东西收好，别丢了。
lines.en: Put your things away, so you do not lose them.

lines.zh: 这些我见得多了，不稀奇。
lines.en: I have seen plenty of this; nothing new.

lines.zh: 你的心意我收了。
lines.en: I accept your intention.

lines.zh: 坐下吧，慢慢说。
lines.en: Sit down and tell me slowly.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，自己反倒晃了。
lines.en: You bump into me and end up swaying yourself.

lines.zh: 我脚下没动，你已经退了。
lines.en: My feet did not move; you already stepped back.

lines.zh: 让开一点，这里过不去。
lines.en: Step aside a little; you cannot pass here.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我连眼皮都没抬。
lines.en: You bump into me; I don't even lift an eyelid.

lines.zh: 撞上时我手里的茶没洒。
lines.en: The tea in my hand did not spill.

lines.zh: 你这力气，还得再练。
lines.en: With that strength, you need more training.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，给你让路。
lines.en: I turn sideways to let you pass.

lines.zh: 别急，门槛很低。
lines.en: Do not rush; the threshold is low.

lines.zh: 你撞我一下，我记着了。
lines.en: You bumped me once, and I have noted it.

lines.zh: 我往后退半步，整理衣袖。
lines.en: I step back half a pace and smooth my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我没有那种事要做。
lines.en: I have no such business to attend to.

lines.zh: 我在这里守殿，不谈这个。
lines.en: I keep this temple; I do not speak of that.

lines.zh: 我一个人的时候很多。
lines.en: I spend a great deal of time alone.

lines.zh: 你要是想学，我可以多教。
lines.en: If you wish to learn, I can teach more.

lines.zh: 这类话，我听过不少。
lines.en: I have heard such talk before.

lines.zh: 殿里只有我，也没缺什么。
lines.en: Only I am in this hall, and nothing is missing.

lines.zh: 我把心放在别处。
lines.en: My heart is set elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我不会为此离开这里。
lines.en: I will not leave this place for that.

lines.zh: 你问错人了。
lines.en: You are asking the wrong one.

lines.zh: 我笑一笑，不回答。
lines.en: I smile and do not answer.

lines.zh: 我拾起地上的碎瓦，收好。
lines.en: I pick up the broken tile and keep it.

lines.zh: 我把滚落的果子放回盘里。
lines.en: I put the fallen fruit back on the tray.

lines.zh: 捡起来，是我的习惯。
lines.en: Picking things up is a habit of mine.

lines.zh: 这东西你自己收着。
lines.en: You should keep this yourself.

lines.zh: 我弯腰放下，动作很慢。
lines.en: I bend to set it down, moving slowly.

lines.zh: 扫干净了，殿里才像样。
lines.en: Swept clean, the hall is proper.

lines.zh: 我拾起的，都不属于我。
lines.en: Nothing I pick up belongs to me.

lines.zh: 这枚石子，我刚才看见了。
lines.en: I saw this pebble a moment ago.

lines.zh: 我把它放在供桌上。
lines.en: I place it on the offering table.

lines.zh: 你掉了东西，我给你留着。
lines.en: You dropped something; I kept it for you.

lines.zh: 我不锁人，我只认人。
lines.en: I do not lock on; I simply recognise.

lines.zh: 你要学的，我记住了。
lines.en: I will remember what you came to learn.

lines.zh: 我把你记在心里了。
lines.en: I have kept you in mind.

lines.zh: 你站在原地，我看清楚你。
lines.en: Stand where you are while I look at you.

lines.zh: 这次谈话，我认真了。
lines.en: I am taking this conversation seriously.

lines.zh: 我转身面对你，不再背对。
lines.en: I turn to face you instead of turning away.

lines.zh: 你的问题，我听见了。
lines.en: I heard your question.

lines.zh: 我抬起眼，那是我在听。
lines.en: I raise my eyes, and that is me listening.

lines.zh: 我认下你这个学生。
lines.en: I accept you as a student.

lines.zh: 你不用躲，我不会伤你。
lines.en: You need not shy away; I will not hurt you.

lines.zh: 我一直看着你，没移开。
lines.en: I keep watching you without looking away.

lines.zh: 你练的时候，我在旁边。
lines.en: While you train, I am beside you.

lines.zh: 你的动作，我一个个纠正。
lines.en: I correct your movements one at a time.

lines.zh: 我看着你的脚，站不稳。
lines.en: I watch your feet; they are unsteady.

lines.zh: 你别急，我在等你做完。
lines.en: Do not rush; I am waiting for you to finish.

lines.zh: 我没有恶意，只是观察。
lines.en: I mean no harm; I am only observing.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，你就明白了。
lines.en: I stand still, and you will understand.

lines.zh: 我端着茶，在殿里走了一圈。
lines.en: Tea in hand, I make one round of the hall.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，那里在抖。
lines.en: I watch your hands; they are trembling.

lines.zh: 我看你比看天还久。
lines.en: I watch you longer than I watch the sky.

lines.zh: 我不会先动手，你也不该。
lines.en: I will not strike first, and neither should you.

lines.zh: 你挥拳打空了，我只侧了身。
lines.en: Your swing hits air; I only turned aside.

lines.zh: 我的手掌轻轻挡住，你就停了。
lines.en: My palm blocks lightly and you stop.

lines.zh: 打我不算本事。
lines.en: Hitting me proves nothing.

lines.zh: 我用两根手指拨开你的手腕。
lines.en: I brush your wrist aside with two fingers.

lines.zh: 你这一下，角度全错。
lines.en: Your whole angle is wrong.

lines.zh: 我不还手，因为不必还手。
lines.en: I do not hit back, because it is unnecessary.

lines.zh: 再练十年，也打不到我。
lines.en: Train ten more years and you still cannot touch me.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，是你的机会。
lines.en: I stepped back; that is your chance.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，你就收了手。
lines.en: I look up at you, and you lower your hand.

lines.zh: 我站在殿里，好像一直都在。
lines.en: I stand in the hall as if I was always here.

lines.zh: 柱子后面的影子散了，是我。
lines.en: The shadow behind the pillar clears, and it is me.

lines.zh: 我从楼梯上走上来，慢慢地。
lines.en: I come up the stairs, slowly.

lines.zh: 这个地方，我守了很久。
lines.en: I have guarded this place a long time.

lines.zh: 你先看到我的眼睛，再看到人。
lines.en: You see my eyes first, then the rest of me.

lines.zh: 门开了，我就在门里。
lines.en: The door opens, and I am inside it.

lines.zh: 我没有脚步声，你已经知道了。
lines.en: I make no sound, and you already know.

lines.zh: 茶刚泡好，你来了。
lines.en: The tea is just brewed, and you have come.

lines.zh: 我在等你开口问。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to ask.

lines.zh: 殿里的光落在我的脸上。
lines.en: The hall's light falls on my face.

lines.zh: 火苗烧到袖子，我拍了拍。
lines.en: Flame catches my sleeve and I pat it out.

lines.zh: 我从石阶上摔下，扶住了栏杆。
lines.en: I fall on the stairs and catch the rail.

lines.zh: 我不会游水，只能勉强撑住。
lines.en: I cannot swim well and can only barely hold.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推倒，我慢慢爬起来。
lines.en: The blast knocks me down and I rise slowly.

lines.zh: 一支箭插在我肩上，我拔了下来。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder; I draw it out.

lines.zh: 法术压住我，我闭眼忍了。
lines.en: Magic presses on me and I close my eyes and bear it.

lines.zh: 我忘了吃饭，肚子在响。
lines.en: I forgot to eat, and my stomach complains.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，衣角焦了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and my hem is scorched.

lines.zh: 虚空吸我，我抓住殿柱不放。
lines.en: The void pulls me and I cling to the pillar.
